Just updated my AI model routing strategy:

The game has changed.

Before:
• Default to GPT-4 ($2.50/1M tokens)
• Escalate to Claude ($3.00)

Now:
• Default to Kimi-K2.5:cloud ($0.00)
• Quick tasks → GPT-4o-mini ($0.15)
• Complex reasoning → Claude 3.5

Result: 98% cost reduction, same output quality.

The free models got *really* good.
